name: Grips Wrapped on Tool Handles
prompt:
Create ONE Tomorrow and Tomorrow discovery painting. Reference provides established production painting medium/palette ONLY and EXACT EXTRA-WIDE canvas width/aspect. Preserve full bleed. No frame, grid, text or 3:2 crop. NEW SUBJECT: ONE seated adult with exactly TWO hands wraps rough bast fiber around a crooked wood haft holding a flint tool, testing a thicker irregular grip. One finished crude wrapping and loose fiber. Production medium: angular palette-knife PAINTING, flat copper/ember/soot/umber masses, broken pigment, no sculptural relief.
Zoom out: whole heads/hands/working tools within y170..590 of a765px banner, background only beyond, so actual3.37:1 card retains subject. Gameyears34–35: hide/fur garments, raw wood/stone/flint/cordage, early clay pots and modest shelters. Plain weaving is later: no woven clothing, loom, metal or later architecture borrowed from reference.
review: Accepted full original and actual3.37:1 GPU card; chronology, source, focus, provenance and hidden gating pass
